text:
jen: Heads-up — console quota numbers don't match SDK-reported route tags after the compact-routeheader canary. Dashboard shows a big 'unknown' bucket for route attribution.
liam: I reproduced on staging. Console ingestion expects `X-Route-Tags` but the canaryed clients are sending `X-RT` (compact). Parser just drops unknown headers.
priya: Which SDKs are emitting X-RT? Py/TS shipped the shim last week; Go stayed on legacy.
ev an: go client still uses legacy `X-Route-Tags` until next minor.
jen: Example header from a failing request: `X-RT: a1|t=beta,c=teamX` — compact encodes multiple attrs.
samir: Confirmed. The route parser only supports the verbose format, so compacted ones end up in unknown => quota console shows skew.
ops-bot: deploy started: route-parser-service -> staging (route-parser-1.2)
priya: Proposed quick fix: make the parser accept both `X-Route-Tags` and `X-RT` and normalize into canonical route_meta before aggregation. I'll open a PR.
liam: Also we need a rollout plan for SDKs: add a telemetry feature flag `emit_canonical_header` default=false so customers don't flip behavior mid-flight. Rollout over 2 weeks canaryed by tenant.
ev an: For Go SDK this is higher risk (C++ bindings + static linking). Suggest opt-in via ENV var and bump semver Major later if we want default-on.
jen: UX ask for console: surface a banner when unknown-route >5% with a link to migration docs and an explainer for customers.
console-team: can do — need copy and the doc link. Prefer short actionable steps.
priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 adds X-RT parsing + end-to-end tests.
samir: smoke test on staging after PR => unknown bucket dropped 18% -> 1.2% :party_parrot:
liam: Plan: roll parser to prod in ~1h, ship SDK flags in the next release window, docs + console banner by EOD.
jen: Also create an alert: unknown-route >2% across total traffic for 5m -> paging.
ops-bot: alert created: unknown-route-count >2% (5m) -> #incidents
priya: pushed unit tests and small parsing snippet in PR: ```python
def parse_xrt(hdr: str):
    parts = hdr.split('|')
    # parts like ['a1', 't=beta', 'c=teamX']
    return dict(p.split('=') for p in parts[1:] if '=' in p)
```
ev an: Remind me we need to update the telemetry contract doc and metrics mapping table in Confluence before SDKs flip defaults.
jen: Good point — I'll file a docs task and link it from the PR.
liam: thumbs-up to the quick parser fix. After prod roll, we'll do a phased SDK noise reduction and follow up with retro.
jen: Thanks everyone — will follow up with timeline + retro item.
